name: Machines
description: Machines are the representation of items that teach moves to Pokémon. They vary from version to version, so it is not certain that one specific TM or HM corresponds to a single Machine.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The TM or HM item that corresponds to this machine.

fields.name: move
fields.description: The move that is taught by this machine.

fields.name: version_group
fields.description: The version group that this machine applies to.
